WITH pay AS (
    SELECT order_id,
           SUM(paid_amount) AS total,
           MAX(paid_date) AS last_dt
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'payments') }}
    GROUP BY order_id
),
t AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           o.amount,
           CASE WHEN p.order_id IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
                ELSE CAST(p.total AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END AS paid,
           CASE WHEN p.order_id IS NULL THEN CAST(NULL AS DATE)
                ELSE p.last_dt END AS last_paid
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
    LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
)
SELECT order_id,
       amount,
       paid,
       amount - paid AS outstanding,
       last_paid
FROM t

explanation: This procedure builds one row per order showing how much has been paid and what is still owed. Each order's payments are totaled, and the most recent payment date is recorded. Orders with no payments show zero paid and no last payment date. Outstanding is the order amount minus the amount paid.
